reason: I already pay for a reconciliation/BI tool that flags unbilled licences and over-serviced clients, so this mostly looks like overlap. Even the free audit costs me a 45-minute call and an export in a week I don't have, and a list of 'potential' money still means me going cap in hand to every client.
objection: Potential leakage isn't money in the bank. I'd have to chase every client and risk the relationship, and most of the licence side my existing tool already catches.
would_change_my_mind: Seeing a peer MSP on r/msp or a LinkedIn group show it found billable time and outgrown agreements that Gradient/BrightGauge-style tools missed, and that they actually got paid for it.
